title: Podcast EP380: The Focus and Goals of the UK Semiconductor Centre with Andy McLean
gist: Podcast summary: Daniel Nenni interviews Andy McLean, first CEO of the UK Semiconductor Centre, on its charter to scale the UK semiconductor sector globally, with focus areas in photonics, power management, AI, smart grid and quantum computing; the page is promotional and light on data.
